prompt: check.sh fails: add_item(item, bucket=[]) in registry.py uses a mutable default argument, so the default list persists across calls and add_item("a") followed by add_item("b") returns ["a", "b"] instead of ["b"]. Fix registry.py so each call without an explicit bucket starts empty, while an explicitly passed bucket still accumulates. Do not modify check.sh. Reply DONE once `bash check.sh` prints PASS.
description: Bug fix: mutable default argument leaks state across calls.
